scope: small, non-embedded surface irritant such as dust, grit, or an eyelash with normal vision and no severe pain
patterns: I got dust in my eye
how do I rinse grit from my eye
my eye feels scratchy after sweeping
something tiny is irritating my eye
sand in my eye but I can still see
eye watering after speck got in
response: Wash your hands and do not rub or squeeze the eye. Remove a contact lens if you can do so easily. Gently rinse the eye with clean lukewarm water or sterile saline. Do not use tweezers or cotton swabs, and do not try to remove anything embedded in the eye.
red_flags: any chemical, powder, or spray in the eye
an object embedded in or sticking out of the eye
vision change, blurred or double vision
severe or increasing pain, or bleeding
a painful red eye that keeps hurting after rinsing
